_note: Static snapshot refreshed daily by .github/workflows/sync-icon-sets.yml (bin/sync-icon-sets.php). Each set pins key/package/repository; title, description, license, icon_count, variants and latest_version are synced from the pack's config.json at its latest GitHub tag. To add a set, append key/package/repository and let the workflow fill in the snapshot. ichava:install reads this file only — zero runtime network calls.

sets.title: Tabler Icons
sets.description: Over 5,200 pixel-perfect icons for web apps. Free and open source icons designed with attention to detail to make your design stand out.

sets.title: Flag Icons
sets.description: 271 country flag SVGs sourced from lipis/flag-icons, available in 4x3 and 1x1 aspect ratios. Replaces the flag half of the deprecated simtabi/laflamoji.

sets.title: Emoji Sets
sets.description: Multi-source emoji bundle (Twemoji, OpenMoji color, OpenMoji black). Unicode 17 / Emoji 17 spec. Categorised by Unicode CLDR groups.
